open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intros Hnorm
  induction post <;>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at * <;>
    try simp_all
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      intros x Hin
      omega
    . next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
        exfalso
        specialize Hn ?_
        constructor
        cases Hn
        apply Hfalse
        rfl
    . cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
        exact List.Subset.app
          (List.Subset.trans fn_ih H1)
          (List.Subset.trans e_ih H2)
  case abs ih =>
    cases Hnorm with | abs _ e_normalized => exact ih e_normalized
  case quant trih eih =>
    cases Hnorm with | quant _ _ _ _ tr_normalized e_normalized =>
      exact List.Subset.app (List.Subset.trans trih tr_normalized) (List.Subset.trans eih e_normalized)
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    cases Hnorm with | ite _ _ _ c_normalized t_normalized e_normalized =>
      exact List.Subset.app
        (List.Subset.trans cih c_normalized)
        (List.Subset.app (List.Subset.trans tih t_normalized) (List.Subset.trans eih e_normalized))
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm with | eq _ _ e1_normalized e2_normalized =>
      exact List.Subset.app (List.Subset.trans ih1 e1_normalized) (List.Subset.trans ih2 e2_normalized)
